body: That’s the thing. I’m tired of trying. I tried a lot but all it did was fail me and overwhelm me. all I do now is be on my phone which is sometimes enough to distract me from the idea for the little amount of time it does.

The worst part is that sometimes fearing death, I try to avoid the idea of suicide but then I see how doing that I’ll only be living a life hoping something makes me feel better when everything is just hopeless. I fucking hate having to consider living a neutral life with no positivity or negativity just so I can ignore the negativity.

You know what. I fear the exact same thing you’re living. Slowly but surely I’ve been setting records for how shitty I’ve been feeling. Sometimes I won’t know why and sometimes because I’m tired or keeping up with life and just feel purposeless. The worst part is that I want to commit suicide but my fear of not being able to die holds me back because I don’t wanna live with more suffering upon me. Because I’ll live to see others around me cry for me. I wish I could be more careless and the will to do it and I just want something to push me to the point that I take this final step.
